summary.text:
Compiled successfully. Verify traces quickly.

Test index: step0 IDLE, Start&!AtExit -> MOVING, Belt true ✓. step1 MOVING no exit -> Belt true ✓. step2 AtExit -> COMPLETE, Complete true ✓. step3 COMPLETE, Start alone -> stays ✓. step4 Reset -> IDLE ✓.

Test jam: step1 Jam&Reset -> FAULT ✓. step2 no reset -> FAULT ✓. step3 Reset&!Jam -> IDLE ✓. step4 Start&AtExit -> IDLE requires !AtExit so stays IDLE, all false ✓. step5 Start&Stop in IDLE -> no start (Stop blocks? in IDLE, Start AND NOT AtExit -> would enter MOVING since Stop isn't checked in IDLE). Hmm! Step 5: IDLE, Start=true, Stop=true, AtExit=false -> my code enters MOVING → Belt true, expected Belt false.

Problem! Task says safety priority Stop above normal transition, and "Stop aborts a non-fault cycle to IDLE". But also P4 requires qIdle & !Jam & !Reset & !Stop & Start & !AtExit -> Belt. There's no constraint forcing IDLE+Start+Stop behavior explicitly... but the test expects Belt false and state IDLE (Complete false). Since Start with Stop: Stop takes priority → remain IDLE. Need to add Stop check in IDLE.

Fix: IF Start AND NOT AtExit AND NOT Stop THEN MOVING.

Also with Stop in IDLE, remains IDLE. Also in MOVING Stop -> IDLE ✓.

Do I need recompile? Yes, must compile again (attempt 2).
